name: Miki (Hyōgo, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Miki city emblem in white: a stylised angular character of vertical and horizontal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Miki, a city in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 10 August 1966; the emblem dates from 1 July 1954.

features.role: Miki city emblem — a stylised angular character of vertical and horizontal strokes
